confidence_notes: Available [Pai price estimates](https://hikersbay.com/prices/thailand/pai?lang=en) are approximate and may postdate July. [Local drink ranges](https://thailandjourney.org/the-ultimate-guide-to-pai-nightlife-bars-music-late-night-fun/) suggest cocktails and wine cost roughly twice and three times as much as beer, respectively; wine evidence is limited. Accommodation figures are seasonal model estimates and vary with room quality.
comparable_city_reasoning: Pai estimates are informed by its small, tourism-oriented northern Thai market and checked against restaurant prices in nearby [Chiang Mai](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Chiang-Mai). July accommodation estimates reflect the rainy season.
